subject: delta(client): WF keep plain http out of every connection that signs or sends
note: A plain-http node reply carries no authentication, so the wire's connection binding (localBinding in bindTp1Profile, assertTp1Binding and assertTp1Authority) now takes a canonical https root only, whatever the chain identity; every wire signer and every Node session requires that binding. The node transport owner and the network binder still accept a plain-http root under the approved chain identity for the read-only observer and authority capability. The paid-write planner, the SDK session and the paid approval no longer take a node endpoint rule and keep the provider's https-only check, so the Node session no longer passes canonicalNodeEndpoint to them; createSellerWalletSession builds an https-only owner. node-endpoint.test.mjs now shows the owner and binder reads over http and the staged and keystore compositions refusing tp1_local_binding_invalid before any key load, signature or send.
